questions.question: The time taken by a boat to cover a distance of 60 km downstream is equal to 60% of the time taken by it to cover 75 km upstream. The speed of the stream is 4 km/h. What will be the total time (in hours) that the boat will take to cover 39.2 km in still water and 51.2 km downstream?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of **Time** downstream to **Time** upstream for specific distances: Td = 0.6 × Tᵤ.

60 ÷ (u + 4) = 0.6 × [75 ÷ (u − 4)] ⇒ 60 ÷ (u + 4) = 45 ÷ (u − 4).

By cross-multiplying: 4(u − 4) = 3(u + 4) ⇒ 4u − 16 = 3u + 12 ⇒ u = 28 km/h.

Total time = (39.2 ÷ 28) + (51.2 ÷ (28 + 4)) = 1.4 + 1.6 = 3 hr.

**∴ The correct answer is 3 hr.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Distance downstream (D₁) = 60 km, Distance upstream (D₂) = 75 km.

Stream speed (v) = 4 km/h, Still water speed = u km/h.

New distances: Still water = 39.2 km, Downstream = 51.2 km.

**Formula Used:**

Time = Distance ÷ Speed | Downstream speed = u + v | Upstream speed = u − v

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69069ca3cfd76e66b2136fbdb4414c963aef38a29eff5c9d9893f9a8b726777a.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Time downstream = 60 ÷ (u + 4)

⇒ Time upstream = 75 ÷ (u − 4)

⇒ According to question: 60 ÷ (u + 4) = 0.6 × [75 ÷ (u − 4)]

⇒ 60 ÷ (u + 4) = 45 ÷ (u − 4)

⇒ 60u − 240 = 45u + 180

⇒ 15u = 420 ⇒ u = 28 km/h

⇒ Time in still water = 39.2 ÷ 28 = 1.4 hr

⇒ Time downstream = 51.2 ÷ (28 + 4) = 51.2 ÷ 32 = 1.6 hr

⇒ Total time = 1.4 + 1.6 = 3 hr

**∴ The correct answer is 3 hr.**

**__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed in Water

When moving **Downstream**, the boat speed is added to the stream speed (u + v). When moving **Upstream**, the stream speed is subtracted from the boat speed (u − v).

Speed of Boat and Stream

Speed of boat in still water (u) = (Downstream + Upstream) ÷ 2. Speed of stream (v) = (Downstream − Upstream) ÷ 2.

Average Speed for Round Trip

If a boat travels the same distance upstream and downstream, the Average Speed = (Speedᵤₚ × Speeddₒwₙ) ÷ Speedₛₜᵢₗₗ.</p

questions.question: (15(x²-2 x-15))/(25(x+3)(x²-25)) is equal to :
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Substitute an easy value for x, say x = 0, to quickly find the correct option.

Original expression at x = 0: [15 × (−15)] / [25 × 3 × (−25)] = −225 / −1875 = 3 / 25

Check the given options at x = 0: Option 4 yields 3 / [5(0 + 5)] = 3 / 25

Since the evaluated values match, Option 4 is the correct simplified expression.

**∴ The correct answer is 3 / [5(x + 5)].**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Expression = 15(x² − 2x − 15) / [25(x + 3)(x² − 25)]

**Formula Used:**

a² − b² = (a − b)(a + b)

**Calculations:**

⇒ Factorise the quadratic expression in the numerator:

⇒ x² − 2x − 15 = x² − 5x + 3x − 15 = x(x − 5) + 3(x − 5) = (x − 5)(x + 3)

⇒ Factorise the term in the denominator:

⇒ x² − 25 = x² − 5² = (x − 5)(x + 5)

⇒ Substitute these back into the original fraction:

⇒ [15 × (x − 5)(x + 3)] / [25 × (x + 3)(x − 5)(x + 5)]

⇒ Cancel the common terms (x − 5) and (x + 3) from numerator and denominator:

⇒ 15 / [25 × (x + 5)]

⇒ Divide the constant terms by 5:

⇒ 3 / [5(x + 5)]

**∴ The correct answer is 3 / [5(x + 5)].**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Factorising Quadratic Polynomials

To factorise ax² + bx + c, find two numbers that multiply to ac and add to b, then split the middle term.

Difference of Squares

The algebraic identity a² − b² = (a − b)(a + b) is frequently used to simplify fractions involving squared terms.

Value Substitution Method

For multiple-choice questions involving algebraic expressions, substituting a convenient numerical value (like 0 or 1) can rapidly identify the correct option without full simplification.

questions.question: If each interior angle of a regular polygon is 135°, then the number of sides that polygon has is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For any **regular polygon**, the sum of an **interior angle** and its corresponding **exterior angle** is always 180°.

**Exterior Angle** = 180° − 135° = 45°

The sum of all **exterior angles** of any polygon is always 360°.

Number of sides (n) = 360° ÷ **Exterior Angle**

⇒ n = 360° ÷ 45° = 8

**∴ The correct answer is 8.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Each **interior angle** of a regular polygon = 135°

**Formula Used:**

The measure of each **interior angle** of a **regular polygon** with n sides is given by: [(n − 2) × 180°] ÷ n

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c25370ddc1e814dd919040fbcbc5584e5f6658603d333b6d1ce9667049d89e9e.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 135° = [(n − 2) × 180°] ÷ n

⇒ 135n = (n − 2) × 180

⇒ 135n = 180n − 360

⇒ 180n − 135n = 360

⇒ 45n = 360

⇒ n = 360 ÷ 45

⇒ n = 8

**∴ The correct answer is 8.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Sum of Exterior Angles

For any convex polygon, the sum of all **exterior angles** is always exactly 360°, regardless of the number of sides.

Sum of Interior Angles

The sum of all **interior angles** of a polygon with n sides is calculated using the formula: (n − 2) × 180°.

Exterior Angle of a Regular Polygon

In a **regular polygon**, each **exterior angle** is equal and is given by 360° ÷ n, where n is the number of sides.

Relationship between Angles

At every vertex of a polygon, **Interior Angle** + **Exterior Angle** = 180° because they form a linear pair.</p

questions.question: What is the difference between the total surface area and the curved surface area of a cylinder whose radius is 5 cm and height is 7 cm? (Take π = 3.14)
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

The **difference** between **Total Surface Area (TSA)** and **Curved Surface Area (CSA)** of a cylinder is always equal to the **area of its two circular bases**.

Difference = 2 × π × r²

Difference = 2 × 3.14 × 5²

Difference = 2 × 3.14 × 25 = 50 × 3.14 = 157 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 157 cm².**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Radius (r) = 5 cm

Height (h) = 7 cm

π = 3.14

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/725e89b73da5e952a4398e88f07fec0d6f39e800c6d321e4d7c60f4c1f0b5369.png] 

**Formula Used:**

Curved Surface Area (CSA) = 2 × π × r × h

Total Surface Area (TSA) = 2 × π × r × (h + r)

**Calculations:**

⇒ Difference = TSA − CSA

⇒ Difference = [2 × π × r × (h + r)] − [2 × π × r × h]

⇒ Difference = 2πrh + 2πr² − 2πrh

⇒ Difference = 2 × π × r²

⇒ Difference = 2 × 3.14 × (5)²

⇒ Difference = 2 × 3.14 × 25

⇒ Difference = 157 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 157 cm².**

**__Additional Information__**

Volume of a Cylinder

The volume represents the capacity of the cylinder and is calculated as V = πr²h.

Hollow Cylinder TSA

For a hollow cylinder with external radius R and internal radius r, TSA = 2π(R + r)(h + R − r).

Relationship between CSA and Volume

Volume = (CSA × r) ÷ 2. This formula relates the lateral surface area directly to the volume via the radius.</p

questions.question: The smallest prime number is
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

A **prime number** is a positive integer that has exactly two factors: 1 and itself.

The smallest positive integers are 1 and 2.

Since 1 has only one factor (1), it is not a prime number.

The number 2 has exactly two factors (1 and 2), which makes it the **smallest prime number**.

**∴ The correct answer is 2.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

We analyze the values 0, 1, 2, and 3 to determine the **smallest prime number**.

**Definition of Prime Numbers:**

A prime number is a natural number greater than 1 that is divisible only by 1 and itself.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/09a17cba7e422e7e68f94123ae743d9c8bf909e5d47127e6f220ae5cebbdb511.png] 

**Step-by-step Verification:**

⇒ For **0**: It is not a natural number and has infinitely many factors. ∴ 0 is not a prime number.

⇒ For **1**: The factors of 1 are only {1}. It does not have two distinct positive divisors. By definition, 1 is neither prime nor composite. ∴ 1 is not a prime number.

⇒ For **2**: The factors of 2 are {1, 2}. It has exactly two distinct positive factors. ∴ 2 is a prime number.

⇒ For **3**: The factors of 3 are {1, 3}. It is also a prime number, but since 2 **__Additional Information__**

Even Prime Number

The number 2 is the only even prime number. All other even numbers greater than 2 are composite because they are divisible by 2.

Coprime Numbers

Two numbers are coprime (or relatively prime) if their highest common factor (HCF) is equal to 1. For example, 8 and 15 are coprime.

Composite Numbers

A composite number is a positive integer greater than 1 that has more than two distinct positive divisors. The smallest composite number is 4.

Twin Primes

Pairs of prime numbers that have a difference of exactly 2 are called twin primes, such as (3, 5), (5, 7), and (11, 13).</p

questions.question: How many lead balls of radius 0.5 cm can be made from a sphere whose surface area is 5544 cm²?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of **Volume** of two spheres is the cube of the ratio of their **Radii**.

Surface Area = 4πR² = 5544 ⇒ R² = 5544 ÷ (4 × 22/7) = 441 ⇒ **R = 21 cm**.

Given small radius **r = 0.5 cm**.

Number of lead balls = (R ÷ r)³ = (21 ÷ 0.5)³ = 42³ = 74,088.

**∴ The correct answer is 74,088.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Surface area of the large sphere = 5544 cm²

Radius of small lead balls (r) = 0.5 cm

**Formula Used:**

Surface area of sphere = 4πR²

Volume of sphere = (4/3)πR³

Number of balls (n) = Volume of large sphere ÷ Volume of each small ball

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3aad1156b110a7ed05434cdfc042cd35fcae821c84363217a8d274fd0f6bc33e.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 4 × (22/7) × R² = 5544

⇒ (88/7) × R² = 5544

⇒ R² = (5544 × 7) ÷ 88

⇒ R² = 63 × 7 = 441

⇒ R = √441 = 21 cm

⇒ n = [(4/3) × π × R³] ÷ [(4/3) × π × r³]

⇒ n = (R ÷ r)³

⇒ n = (21 ÷ 0.5)³ = (42)³

⇒ n = 42 × 42 × 42 = 1764 × 42

⇒ n = 74,088

**∴ The correct answer is 74,088.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Properties of Sphere

A sphere is a perfectly round geometrical object in three-dimensional space. Volume V = (4/3)πr³ and Surface Area A = 4πr².

Hemisphere Formulas

For a hemisphere of radius r: Volume = (2/3)πr³, Curved Surface Area (CSA) = 2πr², and Total Surface Area (TSA) = 3πr².

Recasting Rule

When one solid is melted and recast into another solid shape, the **total volume remains constant** (assuming no material loss).</p

questions.question: A person went to a place at a speed of 20 km/h and came back at a speed of 30 km/h. During this journey, if the time taken is 2 hours, determine the distance of that place.
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Use the direct formula for **distance** when **total time** for the round trip is known:

**Distance** = [(Speed₁ × Speed₂) ÷ (Speed₁ + Speed₂)] × **Total Time**

Distance = [(20 × 30) ÷ (20 + 30)] × 2

Distance = [600 ÷ 50] × 2 = 12 × 2 = 24 km.

**∴ The correct answer is 24 km.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed during going (s₁) = 20 km/h

Speed during coming back (s₂) = 30 km/h

**Total time** taken = 2 hours

**Formula Used:**

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/151e6a36e138e2f00604b89917d6dd97aa6dc8849f841a516c8641d701104366.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the **distance** of the place be D km.

⇒ Time taken while going = D ÷ 20

⇒ Time taken while coming back = D ÷ 30

⇒ Total Time = (D ÷ 20) + (D ÷ 30) = 2

⇒ (3D + 2D) ÷ 60 = 2

⇒ 5D ÷ 60 = 2

⇒ D ÷ 12 = 2

⇒ D = 12 × 2

⇒ D = 24 km

**∴ The correct answer is 24 km.**

**__Additional Information__**

Average Speed for Round Trip

When a person travels the same distance at two different speeds x and y, the **Average Speed** is given by (2 × x × y) ÷ (x + y).

Speed-Time Relationship

For a **constant distance**, the time taken is inversely proportional to the speed. Ratio of speeds s₁:s₂ = Ratio of times t₂:t₁.

Unit Conversion

To convert speed from **km/h** to **m/s**, multiply by 5/18. To convert from **m/s** to **km/h**, multiply by 18/5.</p

questions.question: The price of LPG cylinder has increased from Rs. 676 to Rs. 845. What percentage of consumption should be reduced that the amount spent on LPG cylinders remains the same. (% In)

= 169

questions.solution:

To find the difference in the price of a magazine for a customer who buys 45 magazines and a customer who buys 26 magazines,

we need to calculate the discounted prices for each case and then find the difference.

Original price of one magazine = ₹90

Discount = 30% of ₹90

 

Discount = 0.30 × 90 = ₹27

Price after 30% discount = Original price - Discount

 

Price per magazine after 30% discount = 90 - 27 = ₹63 

2. Price after 25% discount for 26 magazines:

Discount = 25% of ₹90

 

Discount = 0.25 × 90 = ₹22.5

Price after 25% discount = Original price - Discount

 

Price per magazine after 25% discount = 90 - 22.5 = ₹67.5

3. Difference in price per magazine:

Difference = 67.5 - 63 = ₹4.5

Therefore, the difference in the price of a magazine for a customer of 45 magazines and a customer of 26 magazines is ₹4.5.

**So, the correct answer is 4.5.**

**Concept used:**

Average = (Sum of all observation) ÷ (Total number of observation)

**Calculation:**

The sum of all given numbers = 17 + 18 + 21 + 26 + 28 = 110

The number of observation = 5

The required average = (110)/(5) = 22

According to the question,

⇒ ? = sqrt{5.5k} - 11

⇒ ? = sqrt{5.5 times 22}- 11

⇒ ? = √121 - 11

⇒ ? = 11 - 11 = 0

**∴ The value of the required expression is 0.**

questions.question:
Consider the following question and decide which of the statements is sufficient to answer the question.

**Question:**

Find the profit share of Neeraj in the business.

**Statements:**

I. Three Partners Neeraj, Ravi and Harleen started a business by investing a capital in the ratio 2 : 3 : 5. The total profit earned is Rs. 2160.

II. The time period for which each of them invested was in the ratio of the reciprocal of the amount invested.

options.text: Either statement I or II is sufficient
Both statements I and II are sufficient

questions.solution:
**Given:**

Ratio of capitals of Neeraj, Ravi and Harleen = 2 : 3 : 5

The total profit earned = Rs. 2160

Time period = 1/amount invested

Formula Used:

Profit earned = Capital invested × Time period

**Calculation:**

**From Statement I:**

Let the ratio of capitals of Neeraj, Ravi and Harleen be 2x, 3x and 5x respectively

Ratio of capitals of Neeraj, Ravi and Harleen = 2x : 3x : 5x

The total profit earned = Rs. 2160

We know that, Profit earned = Capital invested × Time period

Since, the time period for which they have invested is not given, we cannot solve it further

Hence, statement I is insufficient to the answer the question.

**From Statement II:**

The time period for which each of them invested = The reciprocal of the amount invested

Since, the amount and the time period for which they have invested is not given, we cannot solve it further

Hence, statement II is insufficient to the answer the question.

**From Statement I and Statement II:**

Ratio of capitals of Neeraj, Ravi and Harleen = 2x : 3x : 5x

The total profit earned = Rs. 2160

The ratio of time period = 1/amount invested

⇒ 1/2x : 1/3x : 1/5x

Ratio of profit = Capital invested × Time period

⇒ (2x × 1/2x) : (3x × 1/3x) : (5x × 1/5x)

⇒ 1 : 1 : 1

Hence, the profit of all the three partners are same

The profit share of Neeraj = 2160 × 1/3

⇒ 2160/3 

⇒ Rs. 720

**∴ The correct answer is 'Both statements I and II are sufficient'.**

questions.question: A bag contains notes only of Rs. 5, Rs. 10, and Rs. 20. The ratio of the number of Rs. 5 notes to the number of Rs. 10 notes is 11 : 8 and the ratio of Rs. 10 notes to the number of Rs. 20 notes is 10 : 7. The total amount in the bag is Rs. 3,705. The number of Rs. 10 notes in the bag is :
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The ratio of the number of Rs. 5 notes to the number of Rs. 10 notes is 11 : 8

The ratio of the number of Rs. 10 notes to the number of Rs. 20 notes is 10 : 7

The total amount in the bag is Rs. 3,705

**Concept Used:**

Number of Rs. 5 notes × 5 = Total amount of Rs. 5 notes 

Number of Rs. 10 notes × 10 = Total amount of Rs. 10 notes 

Number of Rs. 20 notes × 20 = Total amount of Rs. 10 notes 

**Calculation:**

According to the question 

Rs. 5 notes : Rs. 10 notes = 11 : 8 ----(i)

Rs. 10 notes : Rs. 20 notes = 10 : 7 ----(ii)

On doing (i) × 5 and (ii) × 4, we get 

Rs. 5 notes : Rs. 10 notes = 55 : 40 ----(iii)

Rs. 10 notes : Rs. 20 notes = 40 : 28 ----(iv)

Form equation (iii) and (iv), we get 

Rs. 5 notes : Rs. 10 notes : Rs. 20 notes = 55 : 40 : 28

Now, Let the ratio be x 

So, Number of Rs. 5 notes = 55x 

Number of Rs. 10 notes = 40x 

Number of Rs. 20 notes = 28x 

Now, According to the concept used

55x × 5 + 40x × 10 + 28x × 20 = 3705

⇒ 275x + 400x + 560x = 3705

⇒ 1235x = 3705

⇒ x = 3

So, Rs. 10 notes = 40x

⇒ 40 × 3 = 120

**∴ The number of Rs. 10 notes is 120.**

questions.question: Vikram allows two successive discounts of 20% and 10% on the marked price of a book, which is equal to a single discount of Rs. 252. Then how much profit will Vikram get, on that book, If the cost price is Rs. 600?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Two successive discounts (R% and L%)

R = 20%

L = 10%

Equivalent discount = Rs. 252

Cost price(CP) = Rs. 600

**Formula used**

Equivalent discount = R% + L% - R × L/100

Profit = SP - CP

SP = Market price(MRP) - Discount

**Calculation:** 

Equivalent discount of (20% and 10%) = 20% + 10% - 20 × 10/100

⇒ 28%

Now,

28% - 252

⇒ 1% = 252/28 = 9

MPR(100%) = 9 × 100 = 900 

∴ SP = 900 - 252 = Rs. 648

Since, CP = Rs. 600

**∴ Profit = 648 - 600 = Rs. 48**

questions.question: Martin donates 13% of his Salary to Visually challenged organization, 12% of the Salary to orphanage, 14% of his Salary to Physically challenged organization and 16% of his Salary to the foundations for medical help. The remaining amount Rs.34245 of Salary has been deposited in the bank for monthly expenses. Find the amount donated to Orphanage.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Martin's remaining salary after donations = Rs. 34245

Percentage of salary donated = 13% + 12% + 14% + 16% = 55%

**Concept Used:**

Total Salary = (Remaining amount after donations / Remaining percentage) × 100

Amount donated to Orphanage = (Percentage donation to Orphanage / 100) × Total Salary

**Calculation:**

Total Salary = [34245/(100 - 55)] × 100

⇒ [34245/45] × 100 = Rs. 76100

Amount donated to Orphanage = (12/100) × 76100 = Rs. 9132

**∴ The amount donated to Orphanage is Rs. 9132.**

questions.question:
What is the value of

5 ÷ 10 of 10 × 4 + 4 ÷ 4 of 4 × 10 + (10 - 4) ÷ 16 × 4?

A sum of Rs. 15,000 was lent for 3 years at the rate of 4%, 5%, 6% per annum, respectively, at compound interest for the first year. second year and third year compounded annually. Find the compound interest for 3 years.
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Net multiplying factor for **successive interest rates** = 1.04 × 1.05 × 1.06 = 1.15752

Total **Amount** = 15000 × 1.15752 = Rs. 17,362.80

**Compound Interest** = Amount − Principal = 17362.80 − 15000 = Rs. 2,362.80

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 2362.80.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal (P) = **Rs. 15,000**

Rate for 1st year (r₁) = **4%**

Rate for 2nd year (r₂) = **5%**

Rate for 3rd year (r₃) = **6%**

**Formula Used:**

Amount (A) = P × (1 + r₁/100) × (1 + r₂/100) × (1 + r₃/100)

Compound Interest (CI) = **Amount − Principal**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15e4e9735181a5cb4ad4da41860fb090956670a1d0b0741fcd003c0a4ee230d7.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ A = 15000 × (1 + 4/100) × (1 + 5/100) × (1 + 6/100)

⇒ A = 15000 × (104/100) × (105/100) × (106/100)

⇒ A = 15000 × 1.04 × 1.05 × 1.06

⇒ A = 15600 × 1.05 × 1.06

⇒ A = 16380 × 1.06 = 17362.80

⇒ CI = 17362.80 − 15000 = 2362.80

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 2362.80.**

**__Additional Information__**

Successive Percentage Change

When the rate of interest changes every year, the effective rate can be calculated using the successive change formula: Net % = a + b + (a × b)/100 for two years.

Difference between CI and SI

For a period of 2 years at the same rate R, the difference between CI and SI is P × (R/100)². For the first year, CI and SI are always equal if compounded annually.

Amount for n different rates

Amount = P × (1 + r₁/100) × (1 + r₂/100) × ... × (1 + rₙ/100). This formula accounts for yearly compounding with varied interest rates.</p

questions.question: Find the value of k for which the quadratic equation (3k + 1)x² + 2(k + 1)x + 1 = 0 has equal roots.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For equal roots in ax² + bx + c = 0, Discriminant D = b² − 4ac = 0 ⇒ b² = 4ac.

Substitute the given equation values directly:

[2(k + 1)]² = 4 × (3k + 1) × 1

4(k² + 2k + 1) = 12k + 4

4k² − 4k = 0 ⇒ 4k(k − 1) = 0 ⇒ k = 0 or 1.

**∴ The correct answer is k = 0 and k = 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Quadratic equation: (3k + 1)x² + 2(k + 1)x + 1 = 0

**Formula Used:**

For a standard quadratic equation ax² + bx + c = 0, if the roots are equal, then its Discriminant (D) = b² − 4ac = 0

**Calculation:**

⇒ Comparing the given equation with ax² + bx + c = 0, we get:

⇒ a = (3k + 1), b = 2(k + 1), c = 1

⇒ b² − 4ac = 0

⇒ [2(k + 1)]² − 4 × (3k + 1) × 1 = 0

⇒ 4(k + 1)² − 4(3k + 1) = 0

⇒ 4(k² + 2k + 1) − 12k − 4 = 0

⇒ 4k² + 8k + 4 − 12k − 4 = 0

⇒ 4k² − 4k = 0

⇒ 4k(k − 1) = 0

⇒ k = 0 or k = 1

Checking condition for quadratic equation (a ≠ 0):

⇒ For k = 0, a = 3(0) + 1 = 1 ≠ 0

⇒ For k = 1, a = 3(1) + 1 = 4 ≠ 0

⇒ Both values of k satisfy the required condition.

**∴ The correct answer is k = 0 and k = 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Nature of Roots

For the quadratic equation ax² + bx + c = 0, the discriminant is D = b² − 4ac. Roots are real and distinct if D > 0, real and equal if D = 0, and complex or imaginary if D < 0.

Sum and Product of Roots

If α and β are the roots of the equation ax² + bx + c = 0, then Sum of roots (α + β) = −b ÷ a and Product of roots (α×β) = c ÷ a.

Forming a Quadratic Equation

If roots are given, the quadratic equation can be directly written as: x² − (Sum of roots)x + (Product of roots) = 0.

questions.question: A car left 42 minutes early than the scheduled time but in order to reach its destination 210 km away in time, it had to slow its usual speed by 10 km/hr. What is the usual speed of the car?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Distance to destination = 210 km

Time left early = 42 minutes = 42/60 hours = 0.7 hours

Reduction in speed = 10 km/hr

**Formula Used:**

Let the usual speed of the car be x km/hr.

Time = Distance / Speed

**Calculation:**

Let usual speed of car be ‘x’ km/hr,

A car left 42 minutes early than the scheduled time and in order to reach the destination 210 km away in time, it has to slow its speed by 10 km/hr from the usual,

⇒ 210/ (x – 10) – 210/x = 42/60

⇒ 210 × [1/ (x – 10) – 1/x] = 7/10

⇒ 30 × [(x - x + 10)/(x² - 10x)] = 1/10

⇒ 10/(x² - 10x) = 1/300

⇒ 3000 = x² - 10x

⇒ x2 - 10x - 3000 = 0

⇒ x2 - 60x + 50x - 3000 = 0

⇒ x(x - 60) + 50(x - 60) = 0

⇒ (x - 60)(x + 50) = 0

⇒ x = 60 or -50

Since speed cannot be negative, so

∴ Usual speed of car, x = 60 km/hr

questions.question: X takes twice as much time as Y or thrice as much time as Z to finish a job. Working together, the trio can finish the job in 2 days. Y alone can do the work in ______.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Time taken by X = 2 × Time taken by Y

Time taken by X = 3 × Time taken by Z

Time to complete work together = 2 days

**Concept used:**

Efficiency to do a work is inversely proportional to time taken for the same.

Total work = Time × Efficiency

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

Time ratio, X : Y : Z = 6 : 3 : 2

So, Efficiency ratio = 1/6 : 1/3 : 1/2

Multiply each term by 6

⇒ Efficiency ratio = 6/6 : 6/3 : 6/2 = 1 : 2 : 3

Combined efficiency = 6 units

So, total work = 6 units × 2 = 12 units

Efficiency 'of Y = 2 units

So, time taken by Y alone to do the work = 12/2 = 6 days

**∴ Y will finish the work alone in 6 days.**

questions.question: What will be the compound interest (compounding annually) on a principle sum of Rs. 72000 for 3 years at the rate of 16 percent per annum?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

The **Effective Rate** for 16% over 3 years = 3r + 3r²/100 + r³/10000.

Effective Rate = 3(16) + 3(256)/100 + 4096/10000 = 48 + 7.68 + 0.4096 = **56.0896%**.

**Compound Interest** = 72000 × 56.0896% = Rs. 40384.512.

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 40384.51.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** **Principal (P)** = Rs. 72000, **Rate of Interest (R)** = 16% per annum, **Time (n)** = 3 years.

**Formula:** Amount (A) = P × (1 + R/100)ⁿ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3c3487615b9c84d63e3c628b9aaeca97928282767639c192b9a1bf428cd7c20c.png] 

⇒ Amount (A) = 72000 × (1 + 16/100)³

⇒ A = 72000 × (1.16)³

⇒ A = 72000 × 1.560896

⇒ A = Rs. 112384.512

⇒ **Compound Interest (CI)** = Amount − Principal

⇒ CI = 112384.512 − 72000

⇒ CI = Rs. 40384.512

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 40384.51.**

**__Additional Information__**

Effective Rate for Compound Interest

For 3 years, the effective rate is given by 3r + 3r²/100 + r³/10000, where r is the annual interest rate.

Difference between CI and SI for 3 Years

The difference (D) between compound interest and simple interest for 3 years is D = P(R/100)² × (3 + R/100).

Successive Percentage Change

Compound interest is a practical application of **successive percentage increases**, where each year's interest is calculated on the updated principal.</p
